requirements: R1: Patch task status synchronization logic to verify actual GitHub PR merge states and correct internal statuses.

slices.title: Patch GitHub task status synchronization
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status synchronization patch for this epic, I want to verify the true GitHub PR state, so that tasks are not falsely marked as done when their changes were never merged.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an internal task marked as done with a closed PR without merge,
When the status synchronization runs,
Then the internal task status is reverted to incomplete.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce internal task status mismatches to 0

requirements: R1: Remove hardcoded coverage stubs in audits to ensure actual test metrics are evaluated.

slices.title: Patch audit logic to remove coverage stubs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the audit patch for this epic, I want to remove hardcoded coverage stubs, so that falsified success reports are blocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an automated audit execution,
When coverage metrics are retrieved,
Then actual test coverage data is used instead of hardcoded stubs.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce fraudulent audit success reports to 0

epics.title: Resolve Jules API Client Payload Limits
epics.jtbd: When a system operator runs the pipeline, I want the API client to support payloads larger than 10MB, so that the pipeline does not stall during transmission.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce pipeline stalls caused by API payload limits to 0
requirements: R1: Update JulesApiClient configuration to support payloads larger than 10MB without stalling.

slices.title: Patch JulesApiClient payload configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing the payload limit fix for this epic, I want to increase the API client payload limit, so that the pipeline does not stall during transmission.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a JulesApiClient instance processing a request,
When a payload exceeding 10MB is submitted,
Then the request completes successfully without stalling the pipeline.
